TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.merge_percent

MERGE TOP (0) PERCENT dbo.merge_percent AS t
       USING (SELECT id FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6),(7)) AS v(id) WHERE id<=7) AS s ON t.id=s.id
       WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id) VALUES (s.id)
       OUTPUT $action AS action, inserted.id AS inserted_id;
